def count_Set_Bits(n) :  
    n += 1; 
    powerOf2 = 2;   
    cnt = n // 2;  
    while (powerOf2 <= n) : 
        totalPairs = n // powerOf2;  
        cnt += (totalPairs // 2) * powerOf2;  
        if (totalPairs & 1) : 
            cnt += (n % powerOf2) 
        else : 
            cnt += 0
        powerOf2 <<= 1;    
    return cnt;

def product_Equal(n): 
    if n < 10: 
        return False
    prodOdd = 1; prodEven = 1
    while n > 0: 
        digit = n % 10
        prodOdd *= digit 
        n = n//10
        if n == 0: 
            break; 
        digit = n % 10
        prodEven *= digit 
        n = n//10
    if prodOdd == prodEven: 
        return True
    return False

def count_Fac(n):  
    m = n 
    count = 0
    i = 2
    while((i * i) <= m): 
        total = 0
        while (n % i == 0): 
            n /= i 
            total += 1 
        temp = 0
        j = 1
        while((temp + j) <= total): 
            temp += j 
            count += 1
            j += 1 
        i += 1
    if (n != 1): 
        count += 1 
    return count

import math
import sys
def sd_calc(data):
    n = len(data)
    if n <= 1:
        return 0.0
    mean, sd = avg_calc(data), 0.0
    for el in data:
        sd += (float(el) - mean)**2
    sd = math.sqrt(sd / float(n-1))
    return sd
def avg_calc(ls):
    n, mean = len(ls), 0.0
    if n <= 1:
        return ls[0]
    for el in ls:
        mean = mean + float(el)
    mean = mean / float(n)
    return mean

def maxAverageOfPath(cost, N): 
dp = [[0 for i in range(N + 1)] for j in range(N + 1)] 
dp[0][0] = cost[0][0] 
for i in range(1, N): 
dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + cost[i][0] 
for j in range(1, N): 
dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1] + cost[0][j] 
for i in range(1, N): 
for j in range(1, N): 
dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], 
dp[i][j - 1]) + cost[i][j] 
return dp[N - 1][N - 1] / (2 * N - 1)

def find_first_occurrence(A, x):
    (left, right) = (0, len(A) - 1)
    result = -1
    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if x == A[mid]:
            result = mid
            right = mid - 1
        elif x < A[mid]:
            right = mid - 1
        else:
            left = mid + 1
    return result

def sum_Of_Subarray_Prod(arr,n):
    ans = 0
    res = 0
    i = n - 1
    while (i >= 0):
        incr = arr[i]*(1 + res)
        ans += incr
        res = incr
        i -= 1
    return (ans)

def set_middle_bits(n):  
    n |= n >> 1; 
    n |= n >> 2; 
    n |= n >> 4; 
    n |= n >> 8; 
    n |= n >> 16;  
    return (n >> 1) ^ 1
def toggle_middle_bits(n): 
    if (n == 1): 
        return 1
    return n ^ set_middle_bits(n)

def lcs_of_three(X, Y, Z, m, n, o): 
L = [[[0 for i in range(o+1)] for j in range(n+1)] 
for k in range(m+1)] 
for i in range(m+1): 
for j in range(n+1): 
for k in range(o+1): 
if (i == 0 or j == 0 or k == 0): 
L[i][j][k] = 0
elif (X[i-1] == Y[j-1] and
X[i-1] == Z[k-1]): 
L[i][j][k] = L[i-1][j-1][k-1] + 1
else: 
L[i][j][k] = max(max(L[i-1][j][k], 
L[i][j-1][k]), 
L[i][j][k-1]) 
return L[m][n][o]

def check_min_heap(arr, i):
    if 2 * i + 2 > len(arr):
        return True
    left_child = (arr[i] <= arr[2 * i + 1]) and check_min_heap(arr, 2 * i + 1)
    right_child = (2 * i + 2 == len(arr)) or (arr[i] <= arr[2 * i + 2] 
                                      and check_min_heap(arr, 2 * i + 2))
    return left_child and right_child

def jacobsthal_num(n): 
dp = [0] * (n + 1) 
dp[0] = 0
dp[1] = 1
for i in range(2, n+1): 
dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + 2 * dp[i - 2] 
return dp[n]

def second_smallest(numbers):
  if (len(numbers)<2):
    return
  if ((len(numbers)==2)  and (numbers[0] == numbers[1]) ):
    return
  dup_items = set()
  uniq_items = []
  for x in numbers:
    if x not in dup_items:
      uniq_items.append(x)
      dup_items.add(x)
  uniq_items.sort()    
  return  uniq_items[1]

def check_Odd_Parity(x): 
    parity = 0
    while (x != 0): 
        x = x & (x - 1) 
        parity += 1
    if (parity % 2 == 1): 
        return True
    else: 
        return False

from collections import deque
def check_expression(exp):
    if len(exp) & 1:
        return False
    stack = deque()
    for ch in exp:
        if ch == '(' or ch == '{' or ch == '[':
            stack.append(ch)
        if ch == ')' or ch == '}' or ch == ']':
            if not stack:
                return False
            top = stack.pop()
            if (top == '(' and ch != ')') or (top == '{' and ch != '}' or (top == '[' and ch != ']')):
                return False
    return not stack

def count_vowels(test_str):
  res = 0
  vow_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
  for idx in range(1, len(test_str) - 1):
    if test_str[idx] not in vow_list and (test_str[idx - 1] in vow_list or test_str[idx + 1] in vow_list):
      res += 1
  if test_str[0] not in vow_list and test_str[1] in vow_list:
    res += 1
  if test_str[-1] not in vow_list and test_str[-2] in vow_list:
    res += 1
  return (res)

def find_Sum(arr,n): 
    arr.sort() 
    sum = arr[0] 
    for i in range(0,n-1): 
        if (arr[i] != arr[i+1]): 
            sum = sum + arr[i+1]   
    return sum

import math 
def count_Divisors(n) : 
    count = 0
    for i in range(1, (int)(math.sqrt(n)) + 2) : 
        if (n % i == 0) : 
            if( n // i == i) : 
                count = count + 1
            else : 
                count = count + 2
    if (count % 2 == 0) : 
        return ("Even") 
    else : 
        return ("Odd")

def Odd_Length_Sum(arr):
    Sum = 0
    l = len(arr)
    for i in range(l):
        Sum += ((((i + 1) *(l - i) + 1) // 2) * arr[i])
    return Sum

def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    r, g, b = r/255.0, g/255.0, b/255.0
    mx = max(r, g, b)
    mn = min(r, g, b)
    df = mx-mn
    if mx == mn:
        h = 0
    elif mx == r:
        h = (60 * ((g-b)/df) + 360) % 360
    elif mx == g:
        h = (60 * ((b-r)/df) + 120) % 360
    elif mx == b:
        h = (60 * ((r-g)/df) + 240) % 360
    if mx == 0:
        s = 0
    else:
        s = (df/mx)*100
    v = mx*100
    return h, s, v

def mul_even_odd(list1):
    first_even = next((el for el in list1 if el%2==0),-1)
    first_odd = next((el for el in list1 if el%2!=0),-1)
    return (first_even*first_odd)

def last(arr,x,n):
    low = 0
    high = n - 1
    res = -1  
    while (low <= high):
        mid = (low + high) // 2 
        if arr[mid] > x:
            high = mid - 1
        elif arr[mid] < x:
            low = mid + 1
        else:
            res = mid
            low = mid + 1
    return res

def is_Perfect_Square(n) :
    i = 1
    while (i * i<= n):
        if ((n % i == 0) and (n / i == i)):
            return True     
        i = i + 1
    return False

def sort_by_dnf(arr, n):
  low=0
  mid=0
  high=n-1
  while mid <= high:
    if arr[mid] == 0:
      arr[low], arr[mid] = arr[mid], arr[low]
      low = low + 1
      mid = mid + 1
    elif arr[mid] == 1:
      mid = mid + 1
    else:
      arr[mid], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[mid]
      high = high - 1
  return arr

def count_duplic(lists):
    element = []
    frequency = []
    if not lists:
        return element
    running_count = 1
    for i in range(len(lists)-1):
        if lists[i] == lists[i+1]:
            running_count += 1
        else:
            frequency.append(running_count)
            element.append(lists[i])
            running_count = 1
    frequency.append(running_count)
    element.append(lists[i+1])
    return element,frequency

import re
def pass_validity(p):
 x = True
 while x:  
    if (len(p)<6 or len(p)>12):
        break
    elif not re.search("[a-z]",p):
        break
    elif not re.search("[0-9]",p):
        break
    elif not re.search("[A-Z]",p):
        break
    elif not re.search("[$#@]",p):
        break
    elif re.search("\s",p):
        break
    else:
        return True
        x=False
        break

 if x:
    return False

def check_Type_Of_Triangle(a,b,c): 
    sqa = pow(a,2) 
    sqb = pow(b,2) 
    sqc = pow(c,2) 
    if (sqa == sqa + sqb or sqb == sqa + sqc or sqc == sqa + sqb): 
        return ("Right-angled Triangle") 
    elif (sqa > sqc + sqb or sqb > sqa + sqc or sqc > sqa + sqb): 
        return ("Obtuse-angled Triangle") 
    else: 
        return ("Acute-angled Triangle")

def count_alpha_dig_spl(string):
  alphabets=digits = special = 0
  for i in range(len(string)):
    if(string[i].isalpha()):
        alphabets = alphabets + 1
    elif(string[i].isdigit()):
        digits = digits + 1
    else:
        special = special + 1
  return (alphabets,digits,special)

def generate_matrix(n):
        if n<=0:
            return [] 
        matrix=[row[:] for row in [[0]*n]*n]        
        row_st=0
        row_ed=n-1        
        col_st=0
        col_ed=n-1
        current=1        
        while (True):
            if current>n*n:
                break
            for c in range (col_st, col_ed+1):
                matrix[row_st][c]=current
                current+=1
            row_st+=1
            for r in range (row_st, row_ed+1):
                matrix[r][col_ed]=current
                current+=1
            col_ed-=1
            for c in range (col_ed, col_st-1, -1):
                matrix[row_ed][c]=current
                current+=1
            row_ed-=1
            for r in range (row_ed, row_st-1, -1):
                matrix[r][col_st]=current
                current+=1
            col_st+=1
        return matrix

from sys import maxsize 
def max_sub_array_sum(a,size): 
max_so_far = -maxsize - 1
max_ending_here = 0
start = 0
end = 0
s = 0
for i in range(0,size): 
max_ending_here += a[i] 
if max_so_far < max_ending_here: 
max_so_far = max_ending_here 
start = s 
end = i 
if max_ending_here < 0: 
max_ending_here = 0
s = i+1
return (end - start + 1)

def cube_Sum(n): 
    sum = 0   
    for i in range(0,n) : 
        sum += (2*i+1)*(2*i+1)*(2*i+1) 
    return sum

def min_Swaps(s1,s2) :  
    c0 = 0; c1 = 0;  
    for i in range(len(s1)) :  
        if (s1[i] == '0' and s2[i] == '1') : 
            c0 += 1;    
        elif (s1[i] == '1' and s2[i] == '0') : 
            c1 += 1;  
    result = c0 // 2 + c1 // 2;  
    if (c0 % 2 == 0 and c1 % 2 == 0) : 
        return result;  
    elif ((c0 + c1) % 2 == 0) : 
        return result + 2;  
    else : 
        return -1;

def sort_tuple(tup): 
n = len(tup) 
for i in range(n): 
for j in range(n-i-1): 
if tup[j][0] > tup[j + 1][0]: 
tup[j], tup[j + 1] = tup[j + 1], tup[j] 
return tup

def get_odd_occurence(arr, arr_size):
  for i in range(0, arr_size):
    count = 0
    for j in range(0, arr_size):
      if arr[i] == arr[j]:
        count += 1
    if (count % 2 != 0):
      return arr[i]
  return -1

import heapq
def nth_super_ugly_number(n, primes):
    uglies = [1]
    def gen(prime):
        for ugly in uglies:
            yield ugly * prime
    merged = heapq.merge(*map(gen, primes))
    while len(uglies) < n:
        ugly = next(merged)
        if ugly != uglies[-1]:
            uglies.append(ugly)
    return uglies[-1]

def get_Number(n, k): 
    arr = [0] * n; 
    i = 0; 
    odd = 1; 
    while (odd <= n):   
        arr[i] = odd; 
        i += 1; 
        odd += 2;
    even = 2; 
    while (even <= n): 
        arr[i] = even; 
        i += 1;
        even += 2; 
    return arr[k - 1];

    if (n <= 1):

def find_platform(arr, dep, n): 
    arr.sort() 
    dep.sort() 
    plat_needed = 1
    result = 1
    i = 1
    j = 0
    while (i < n and j < n): 
        if (arr[i] <= dep[j]):           
            plat_needed+= 1
            i+= 1
        elif (arr[i] > dep[j]):           
            plat_needed-= 1
            j+= 1
        if (plat_needed > result):  
            result = plat_needed           
    return result

import math
def sum_of_odd_Factors(n): 
    res = 1
    while n % 2 == 0: 
        n = n // 2 
    for i in range(3,int(math.sqrt(n) + 1)): 
        count = 0
        curr_sum = 1
        curr_term = 1
        while n % i == 0: 
            count+=1 
            n = n // i 
            curr_term *= i 
            curr_sum += curr_term    
        res *= curr_sum  
    if n >= 2: 
        res *= (1 + n) 
    return res

def find_Min_Swaps(arr,n) : 
    noOfZeroes = [0] * n 
    count = 0 
    noOfZeroes[n - 1] = 1 - arr[n - 1] 
    for i in range(n-2,-1,-1) : 
        noOfZeroes[i] = noOfZeroes[i + 1] 
        if (arr[i] == 0) : 
            noOfZeroes[i] = noOfZeroes[i] + 1
    for i in range(0,n) : 
        if (arr[i] == 1) : 
            count = count + noOfZeroes[i] 
    return count

def is_Isomorphic(str1,str2):          
    dict_str1 = {}
    dict_str2 = {}
    for i, value in enumerate(str1):
        dict_str1[value] = dict_str1.get(value,[]) + [i]        
    for j, value in enumerate(str2):
        dict_str2[value] = dict_str2.get(value,[]) + [j]
    if sorted(dict_str1.values()) == sorted(dict_str2.values()):
        return True
    else:
        return False

def max_sum_subseq(A):
    n = len(A)
    if n == 1:
        return A[0]
    look_up = [None] * n
    look_up[0] = A[0]
    look_up[1] = max(A[0], A[1])
    for i in range(2, n):
        look_up[i] = max(look_up[i - 1], look_up[i - 2] + A[i])
        look_up[i] = max(look_up[i], A[i])
    return look_up[n - 1]

def smallest_multiple(n):
    if (n<=2):
      return n
    i = n * 2
    factors = [number  for number in range(n, 1, -1) if number * 2 > n]
    while True:
        for a in factors:
            if i % a != 0:
                i += n
                break
            if (a == factors[-1] and i % a == 0):
                return i

def binomial_coeff(n, k): 
C = [[0 for j in range(k + 1)] 
for i in range(n + 1)] 
for i in range(0, n + 1): 
for j in range(0, min(i, k) + 1): 
if (j == 0 or j == i): 
C[i][j] = 1
else: 
C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] 
+ C[i - 1][j]) 
return C[n][k] 
def lobb_num(n, m): 
return (((2 * m + 1) *
binomial_coeff(2 * n, m + n)) 
/ (m + n + 1))

def coin_change(S, m, n): 
    table = [[0 for x in range(m)] for x in range(n+1)] 
    for i in range(m): 
        table[0][i] = 1
    for i in range(1, n+1): 
        for j in range(m): 
            x = table[i - S[j]][j] if i-S[j] >= 0 else 0
            y = table[i][j-1] if j >= 1 else 0 
            table[i][j] = x + y   
    return table[n][m-1]

def max_product(arr): 
    arr_len = len(arr) 
    if (arr_len < 2): 
        return None     
    x = arr[0]; y = arr[1]    
    for i in range(0, arr_len): 
        for j in range(i + 1, arr_len): 
            if (arr[i] * arr[j] > x * y): 
                x = arr[i]; y = arr[j] 
    return x,y

def super_seq(X, Y, m, n):
if (not m):
return n
if (not n):
return m
if (X[m - 1] == Y[n - 1]):
return 1 + super_seq(X, Y, m - 1, n - 1)
return 1 + min(super_seq(X, Y, m - 1, n),super_seq(X, Y, m, n - 1))

import sys 

def find_closet(A, B, C, p, q, r): 
diff = sys.maxsize 
res_i = 0
res_j = 0
res_k = 0
i = 0
j = 0
k = 0
while(i < p and j < q and k < r): 
minimum = min(A[i], min(B[j], C[k])) 
maximum = max(A[i], max(B[j], C[k])); 
if maximum-minimum < diff: 
res_i = i 
res_j = j 
res_k = k 
diff = maximum - minimum; 
if diff == 0: 
break
if A[i] == minimum: 
i = i+1
elif B[j] == minimum: 
j = j+1
else: 
k = k+1
return A[res_i],B[res_j],C[res_k]

def heap_sort(arr):
    heapify(arr)  
    end = len(arr) - 1
    while end > 0:
        arr[end], arr[0] = arr[0], arr[end]
        shift_down(arr, 0, end - 1)
        end -= 1
    return arr

def heapify(arr):
    start = len(arr) // 2
    while start >= 0:
        shift_down(arr, start, len(arr) - 1)
        start -= 1
def shift_down(arr, start, end):
    root = start
    while root * 2 + 1 <= end:
        child = root * 2 + 1
        if child + 1 <= end and arr[child] < arr[child + 1]:
            child += 1
        if child <= end and arr[root] < arr[child]:
            arr[root], arr[child] = arr[child], arr[root]
            root = child
        else:
            return

def nCr_mod_p(n, r, p): 
if (r > n- r): 
r = n - r 
C = [0 for i in range(r + 1)] 
C[0] = 1 
for i in range(1, n + 1): 
for j in range(min(i, r), 0, -1): 
C[j] = (C[j] + C[j-1]) % p 
return C[r]

def subset(ar, n): 
    res = 0
    ar.sort() 
    for i in range(0, n) : 
        count = 1
        for i in range(n - 1): 
            if ar[i] == ar[i + 1]: 
                count+=1
            else: 
                break 
        res = max(res, count)  
    return res

    return amount
 else:

def is_abundant(n):
    fctrsum = sum([fctr for fctr in range(1, n) if n % fctr == 0])
    return fctrsum > n

def int_to_roman( num):
        val = [1000, 900, 500, 400,100, 90, 50, 40,10, 9, 5, 4,1]
        syb = ["M", "CM", "D", "CD","C", "XC", "L", "XL","X", "IX", "V", "IV","I"]
        roman_num = ''
        i = 0
        while  num > 0:
            for _ in range(num // val[i]):
                roman_num += syb[i]
                num -= val[i]
            i += 1
        return roman_num

def get_noOfways(n):
    if (n == 0):
        return 0;
    if (n == 1):
        return 1; 
    return get_noOfways(n - 1) + get_noOfways(n - 2);

def roman_to_int(s):
        rom_val = {'I': 1, 'V': 5, 'X': 10, 'L': 50, 'C': 100, 'D': 500, 'M': 1000}
        int_val = 0
        for i in range(len(s)):
            if i > 0 and rom_val[s[i]] > rom_val[s[i - 1]]:
                int_val += rom_val[s[i]] - 2 * rom_val[s[i - 1]]
            else:
                int_val += rom_val[s[i]]
        return int_val

def sum_Natural(n): 
    sum = (n * (n + 1)) 
    return int(sum) 
def sum_Even(l,r): 
    return (sum_Natural(int(r / 2)) - sum_Natural(int((l - 1) / 2)))

def discriminant_value(x,y,z):
    discriminant = (y**2) - (4*x*z)
    if discriminant > 0:
        return ("Two solutions",discriminant)
    elif discriminant == 0:
        return ("one solution",discriminant)
    elif discriminant < 0:
        return ("no real solution",discriminant)

def camel_to_snake(text):
        import re
        str1 = re.sub('(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)', r'\1_\2', text)
        return re.sub('([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1_\2', str1).lower()

def floor_Max(A,B,N):
    x = min(B - 1,N)

def join_tuples(test_list):
  res = []
  for sub in test_list:
    if res and res[-1][0] == sub[0]:
      res[-1].extend(sub[1:])
    else:
      res.append([ele for ele in sub])
  res = list(map(tuple, res))
  return (res)

    if x < y:
        return x
    return y

def maximum_segments(n, a, b, c) : 
dp = [-1] * (n + 10) 
dp[0] = 0
for i in range(0, n) : 
if (dp[i] != -1) : 
if(i + a <= n ): 
dp[i + a] = max(dp[i] + 1, 
dp[i + a]) 
if(i + b <= n ): 
dp[i + b] = max(dp[i] + 1, 
dp[i + b]) 
if(i + c <= n ): 
dp[i + c] = max(dp[i] + 1, 
dp[i + c]) 
return dp[n]

def left_rotate(s,d):

def min_sum_path(A): 
memo = [None] * len(A) 
n = len(A) - 1
for i in range(len(A[n])): 
memo[i] = A[n][i] 
for i in range(len(A) - 2, -1,-1): 
for j in range( len(A[i])): 
memo[j] = A[i][j] + min(memo[j], 
memo[j + 1]) 
return memo[0]

class SimpleNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SimpleNN, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(10, 5)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(5, 1)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

class AdvancedNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(AdvancedNN, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(10, 128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 64)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(64, 32)
        self.fc4 = nn.Linear(32, 1)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = torch.relu(self.fc2(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = torch.relu(self.fc3(x))
        x = self.fc4(x)
        return x

class NLPNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_dim):
        super(NLPNet, self).__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(embed_dim, 1)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x)
        x = self.fc(x)
        return x

class PID:
    def __init__(self, Kp, Ki, Kd):
        self.Kp = Kp
        self.Ki = Ki
        self.Kd = Kd
    def compute(self, setpoint, measured_value):
        error = setpoint - measured_value
        return self.Kp * error

def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a

def list_dir(root):
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        level = root.replace(root, '').count(os.sep)
        indent = ' ' * 4 * level
        print(f'{indent}{os.path.basename(root)}/')
        sub_indent = ' ' * 4 * (level + 1)
        for f in files:
            print(f'{sub_indent}{f}')

def search_file(folder, target):
    for root, _, files in os.walk(folder):
        if target in files:
            return os.path.join(root, target)
    return 'File not found'

def automate_data_entry(data):
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    sheet = wb.active
    sheet['A1'] = 'Name'
    sheet['B1'] = 'Age'
    row = 2
    for name, age in data.items():
        sheet[f'A{row}'] = name
        sheet[f'B{row}'] = age
        row += 1
    wb.save('data.xlsx')

def calculate_bmi(height, weight):
    bmi = weight / (height ** 2)
    return round(bmi, 2)

def caloric_intake(age, gender, activity):
    if gender == 'male':
        base = 10 * weight + 6.25 * height - 5 * age + 5
    else:
        base = 10 * weight + 6.25 * height - 5 * age - 161
    return base * activity

def check_file_integrity(filename, original_hash):
    with open(filename, 'rb') as f:
        file_hash = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
    if file_hash != original_hash:
        print('File integrity compromised.')

class Watcher:
    def run(self):
        event_handler = FileSystemEventHandler()
        observer = Observer()
        observer.schedule(event_handler, 'path/to/watch', recursive=False)
        observer.start()
        event_handler.on_modified = self.check_file_access
    def check_file_access(self, event):
        print(f'File accessed: {event.src_path}')

def custom_data_collator(batch):
    input_ids = [item[0] for item in batch]
    attn_masks = [item[1] for item in batch]
    return {'input_ids': torch.stack(input_ids), 'attention_mask': torch.stack(attn_masks)}

class OnTheFly(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, txt_list, tokenizer):
        self.txt_list = txt_list
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.txt_list)
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        txt = self.txt_list[idx]
        encodings_dict = self.tokenizer(txt, truncation=True, max_length=512, padding='max_length')
        return torch.tensor(encodings_dict['input_ids']), torch.tensor(encodings_dict['attention_mask'])

def organize_files(folder_path):
    for filename in os.listdir(folder_path):
        file_ext = filename.split('.')[-1]
        if not os.path.exists(file_ext):
            os.makedirs(file_ext)
        shutil.move(os.path.join(folder_path, filename), os.path.join(folder_path, file_ext, filename))

def scan_ports(host, port_range):
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=50) as executor:
        for port in port_range:
            future = executor.submit(check_port, host, port)

def check_port(host, port):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(1)
    result = s.connect_ex((host, port))
    if result == 0:
        print(f'Port {port} is open')

def fft(x):
    N = len(x)
    if N <= 1: return x
    even, odd = fft(x[0::2]), fft(x[1::2])
    T = [np.exp(-2j * np.pi * k / N) * odd[k] for k in range(N // 2)]
    return [even[k] + T[k] for k in range(N // 2)] + [even[k] - T[k] for k in range(N // 2)]

class NeuralNetwork:
    def __init__(self, layers):
        self.layers, self.weights = layers, [np.random.randn(y, x) for x, y in zip(layers[:-1], layers[1:])]
    def feedforward(self, a):
        for w in self.weights:
            a = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.dot(w, a)))
        return a

def genetic_algorithm(target):
    population = [''.join(random.choice('01') for _ in range(len(target))) for _ in range(20)]
    while True:
        scores = [(x, sum(c1 != c2 for c1, c2 in zip(x, target))) for x in population]
        scores.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
        if scores[0][1] == 0: return scores[0][0]
        population = [mate(scores[i][0], scores[i+1][0]) for i in range(0, len(scores), 2)]

def markov_chain(text, n=2):
    chain, words = {}, text.split()
    for i in range(len(words) - n):
        key, next_word = tuple(words[i:i + n - 1]), words[i + n - 1]
        chain[key] = chain.get(key, []) + [next_word]
    return chain

def gaussian_elimination(A, b):
    n = len(b)
    for i in range(n):
        max_row = max(range(i, n), key=lambda x: abs(A[x][i]))
        A[[i, max_row]], b[i], b[max_row] = A[[max_row, i]], b[max_row], b[i]
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            factor = A[j][i] / A[i][i]
            A[j] -= factor * A[i]
            b[j] -= factor * b[i]
    return b

def euler_method(f, a, b, y0, h):
    n, y = int((b - a) / h), y0
    for i in range(n):
        y += h * f(a, y)
        a += h
    return y

def monte_carlo_pi(n):
    count = sum(1 for _ in range(n) if random.random()**2 + random.random()**2 <= 1)
    return 4 * count / n

def backpropagation(layers, weights, biases, activation, x, y):
    activations = [x]
    for w, b in zip(weights, biases):
        x = activation(np.dot(w, x) + b)
        activations.append(x)
    delta = (activations[-1] - y) * activation(activations[-1], True)
    for i in range(len(layers) - 2, 0, -1):
        delta = np.dot(weights[i].T, delta) * activation(activations[i], True)
        weights[i] -= delta * activations[i-1].T

def FFT(x):
    N = x.shape[0]
    if N <= 1: return x
    even = FFT(x[::2])
    odd = FFT(x[1::2])
    T = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * np.arange(N // 2) / N)
    return np.concatenate([even + T * odd, even - T * odd])

def newton_raphson(f, f_prime, x0, tol=1e-5):
    x = x0
    while abs(f(x)) > tol:
        x -= f(x) / f_prime(x)
    return x

def runge_kutta_4(f, x0, y0, h, n):
    x, y = x0, y0
    for i in range(n):
        k1 = h * f(x, y)
        k2 = h * f(x + 0.5 * h, y + 0.5 * k1)
        k3 = h * f(x + 0.5 * h, y + 0.5 * k2)
        k4 = h * f(x + h, y + k3)
        y += (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) / 6
        x += h

def lagrange_interpolation(x_values, y_values, x):
    result = 0
    for i in range(len(y_values)):
        term = y_values[i]
        for j in range(len(x_values)):
            if j != i:
                term = term * (x - x_values[j]) / (x_values[i] - x_values[j])
        result += term
    return result

def jacobi(A, b, tol=1e-5):
    x = np.zeros_like(b)
    while True:
        x_new = np.dot(np.linalg.inv(np.diag(np.diag(A))), b - np.dot(A - np.diag(np.diag(A)), x))
        if np.allclose(x, x_new, tol):
            return x_new
        x = x_new

def gauss_seidel(A, b, tol=1e-5):
    x = np.zeros_like(b)
    while True:
        x_new = np.zeros_like(x)
        for i in range(A.shape[0]):
            s1 = np.dot(A[i, :i], x[:i])
            s2 = np.dot(A[i, i + 1:], x[i + 1:])
            x_new[i] = (b[i] - s1 - s2) / A[i, i]
        if np.allclose(x, x_new, atol=tol):
            return x_new
        x = x_new

def estimate_pi(n):
    points_inside_circle = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        x, y = random.random(), random.random()
        if x ** 2 + y ** 2 <= 1:
            points_inside_circle += 1
    return 4 * points_inside_circle / n

def bisection(f, a, b, tol=1e-5):
    c = (a + b) / 2.0
    while abs(f(c)) > tol:
        if f(c) * f(a) < 0:
            b = c
        else:
            a = c
        c = (a + b) / 2.0
    return c

def euler_method(f, y0, t0, t1, h):
    y, t = y0, t0
    while t <= t1:
        y += h * f(t, y)
        t += h
    return y

def dijkstra(graph, start):
    distances = {node: float('inf') for node in graph}
    distances[start] = 0
    pq = [(0, start)]
    while pq:
        current_distance, current_node = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if current_distance > distances[current_node]:
            continue
        for neighbor, weight in graph[current_node].items():
            distance = current_distance + weight
            if distance < distances[neighbor]:
                distances[neighbor] = distance
                heapq.heappush(pq, (distance, neighbor))
    return distances

def list_dict(list_one, list_two):
    """Create a dictionary of elements in the two lists which have the same index."""
    assert len(list_one) == len(list_two), "lists must be same length"
    dict = {}
    for i in range(len(list_one)):
        dict[list_one[i]] = list_two[i]
    return dict

def check_fps():
    t1, cnt, intv = time.time(), 0, 1
    nxt = t1 + intv
    while True:
        cnt += 1
        time.sleep(0.001)
        t2 = time.time()
        if t2 >= nxt:
            print(f'FPS: {cnt / intv}')
            cnt, t1 = 0, t2
            nxt = t2 + intv

class Singleton:
    _instance = None
    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super(Singleton, cls).__new__(cls)
        return cls._instance

def timer(func):
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        start = time.time()
        result = func(*args, **kwargs)
        end = time.time()
        print(f'Time elapsed: {end - start}')
        return result
    return wrapper

class Blockchain:
    def __init__(self):
        self.chain = []
        self.current_transactions = []
    def new_block(self, proof):
        block = {
            'index': len(self.chain) + 1,
            'transactions': self.current_transactions,
            'proof': proof
        }
        self.current_transactions = []
        self.chain.append(block)
        return block

        self.index = index
        self.data = data
        self.previous_hash = previous_hash

def repeat(n):
    def decorator(func):
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            for _ in range(n):
                func(*args, **kwargs)
        return wrapper
    return decorator

def reactions(y, t):
    A, B = y
    k1, k2 = 0.1, 0.2
    dA_dt = -k1*A + k2*B
    dB_dt = k1*A - k2*B
    return [dA_dt, dB_dt]

def solve(bo):
    find = find_empty(bo)
    if not find:
        return True
    else:
        row, col = find
    for i in range(1,10):
        if valid(bo, i, (row, col)):
            bo[row][col] = i
            if solve(bo):
                return True
            bo[row][col] = 0
    return False

class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(Net, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 6, 3)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(6, 16, 3)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.max_pool2d(F.relu(self.conv1(x)), (2, 2))
        x = F.max_pool2d(F.relu(self.conv2(x)), 2)
        return x

def find_duplicates(lst):
    seen = set()
    duplicates = set()
    for x in lst:
        if x in seen:
            duplicates.add(x)
        else:
            seen.add(x)
    return duplicates

def validate_form(form):
    if 'username' in form and 'password' in form:
        username = form['username']
        password = form['password']
        if re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,}$', username) and re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9@#$%^&+=]{8,}$', password):

    return False

def database_operations(db_config):
    try:
        conn = psycopg2.connect(**db_config)
        cursor = conn.cursor()

        # Create a table
        cursor.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255))')

        # Insert data into the table
        cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, email) VALUES ('john_doe', 'john@example.com')")
        cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, email) VALUES ('jane_doe', 'jane@example.com')")

        # Commit changes
        conn.commit()

        # Retrieve data
        cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users')
        records = cursor.fetchall()
        for record in records:
            print(record)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error: {e}')
    finally:
        if conn:
            cursor.close()
            conn.close()

def machine_learning_model(data, labels):
    # Split data into training and test sets
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(data, labels, test_size=0.2)

    # Create and train the model
    model = RandomForestClassifier()
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Make predictions
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    # Calculate accuracy
    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    return acc

class Block:
    def __init__(self, index, transactions, previous_hash):
        self.index = index
        self.transactions = transactions
        self.previous_hash = previous_hash
        self.hash = self.calculate_hash()

    def calculate_hash(self):
        block_string = json.dumps(self.__dict__, sort_keys=True).encode()
        return hashlib.sha256(block_string).hexdigest()

def blockchain_operations():
    # Create genesis block
    genesis_block = Block(0, [], '0')

    # Create new block with transactions
    new_block = Block(1, ['tx1', 'tx2'], genesis_block.hash)

    # Validate the chain
    if new_block.previous_hash == genesis_block.hash:
        print('Blockchain is valid.')
    else:
        print('Blockchain is invalid.')

def nlp_operations(text):
    # Tokenize the text
    tokens = word_tokenize(text)

    # Apply stemming
    stemmer = PorterStemmer()
    stemmed_tokens = [stemmer.stem(token) for token in tokens]

    # Perform Named Entity Recognition
    named_entities = ne_chunk(pos_tag(tokens))

    return {'tokens': tokens, 'stemmed': stemmed_tokens, 'named_entities': named_entities}

def fibonacci(n):
    if n <= 0:
        return 'Invalid input'
    fib_list = [0, 1]
    [fib_list.append(fib_list[-1] + fib_list[-2]) for _ in range(2, n)]
    return fib_list[:n]

def binary_search(arr, target):
    if not arr:
        return 'Array is empty'
    low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid
        low, high = (mid + 1, high) if arr[mid] < target else (low, mid - 1)

def prime_factors(n):
    factors = []
    for divisor in [2, 3]:
        while n % divisor == 0:
            factors.append(divisor)
            n //= divisor
    for divisor in range(5, int(n ** 0.5) + 1, 6):
        while n % divisor == 0:
            factors.append(divisor)
            n //= divisor
        while n % (divisor + 2) == 0:
            factors.append(divisor + 2)
            n //= (divisor + 2)
    if n > 1:
        factors.append(n)
    return factors

def quicksort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[0]
    left = [x for x in arr[1:] if x < pivot]
    middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr[1:] if x > pivot]
    return quicksort(left) + middle + quicksort(right)

def factorial(n, acc=1):
    if n == 0:
        return acc
    return factorial(n-1, n*acc)

def square_root(x):
    if x < 0:
        return 'Invalid input'
    return sqrt(x)

def bubble_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    for i in range(n):
        swapped = False
        for j in range(0, n-i-1):
            if arr[j] > arr[j+1]:
                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]
                swapped = True
        if not swapped:
            break

def web_crawler(start_url, rate_limit=1):
    visited = set()
    stack = [start_url]
    while stack:
        sleep(rate_limit)
        url = stack.pop()
        url_hash = md5(url.encode()).hexdigest()
        if url_hash not in visited:
            visited.add(url_hash)
            links = scrape_links(url)
            stack.extend(links)

def matrix_operations(A, B):
    if A.shape[1] != B.shape[0]:
        return 'Incompatible dimensions'
    dot_product = np.dot(A, B)
    element_wise_sum = np.add(A, B)
    return {'dot_product': dot_product, 'element_wise_sum': element_wise_sum}

def neural_network(X, y):
    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=3)
    model = keras.Sequential([
        keras.layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
        keras.layers.Dropout(0.5),
        keras.layers.Dense(10)
    ])
    model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])
    model.fit(X, y, epochs=20, callbacks=[early_stopping], validation_split=0.2)

def data_augmentation(images):
    augmented_images = []
    for img in images:
        angle = random.uniform(-30, 30)
        tform = AffineTransform(translation=(0, 0))
        rotated_img = warp(img, tform)
        augmented_images.append(rotated_img)
    return augmented_images

def parse_xml(xml_string):
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_string)
    namespace = {'ns': 'http://www.example.com'}
    for child in root.findall('.//ns:element', namespace):
        if 'attribute' in child.attrib:
            print(child.tag, child.attrib)

def generate_report(data):
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    with open('report.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(f'Report generated on: {timestamp}\n')
        for item in data:
            f.write(f'{item}\n')

def process_video(video_path):
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)
    try:
        while True:
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            cv2.imshow('Frame', frame)
            if cv2.waitKey(1) & 0xFF == ord('q'):
                break
    finally:
        cap.release()
        cv2.destroyAllWindows()

def fetch_multiple_apis(api_urls):
    responses = {}
    with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
        future_to_url = {executor.submit(requests.get, url): url for url in api_urls}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(future_to_url):
            url = future_to_url[future]
            try:
                data = future.result().json()
                responses[url] = data
            except Exception as e:
                responses[url] = str(e)
    return responses

def load_and_save_images(image_paths):
    image_objects = [(Path(path), Image.open(path)) for path in image_paths]
    for path_obj, img_obj in image_objects:
        new_path = path_obj.parent / f'new_{path_obj.name}'
        img_obj.save(new_path)

def analyze_audio(audio_path):
    audio_file = AudioSegment.from_file(audio_path)
    loudness = audio_file.dBFS
    samples = np.array(audio_file.get_array_of_samples())
    sampling_rate = audio_file.frame_rate
    fft_output = np.fft.fft(samples)
    return {'loudness': loudness, 'fft_output': fft_output, 'sampling_rate': sampling_rate}

def extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path):
    full_text = ''
    with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:
        pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfFileReader(f)
        for i in range(pdf_reader.numPages):
            page = pdf_reader.getPage(i)
            full_text += page.extract_text() + '\n'
    return full_text

def scrape_webpage(url):
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(total=5, backoff_factor=0.1, status_forcelist=[ 500, 502, 503, 504 ])
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    page = session.get(url, timeout=5)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(page.content, 'html.parser')
    return soup.find_all('a')

def process_csv(file_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, infer_datetime_format=True, low_memory=False)
    df.dropna(inplace=True)
    for col in df.columns:
        if df[col].dtype == object:
            df[col] = df[col].str.strip()
    return df

        return None

def tensorflow_model(train_data, train_labels):
    model = tf.keras.Sequential([
        tf.keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
        tf.keras.layers.Dense(1)
    ])
    model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='mse', metrics=['mae'])
    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=3)
    model.fit(train_data, train_labels, epochs=50, validation_split=0.2, callbacks=[early_stopping])
    loss, mae = model.evaluate(train_data, train_labels)
    print(f'Model evaluation - Loss: {loss}, MAE: {mae}')

def fetch_and_parse(url):
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    if 'captcha' in response.text.lower():
        client = AnticaptchaClient('api_key')
        task = ImageToTextTask(response.content)
        job = client.createTask(task)
        job.join()
        captcha_solution = job.get_captcha_text()
        response = requests.get(url, params={'captcha_solution': captcha_solution}, headers=headers)
    return BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser').find_all('a')

def batch_processing(data):
    if not data:
        return 'No data provided'
    threads = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), 10):
        batch = data[i:i+10]
        thread = Thread(target=process_batch, args=(batch,))
        thread.start()
        threads.append(thread)
    for t in threads:
        t.join()

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):
    if len(y_true) != len(y_pred) or len(y_true) == 0:
        return 'Invalid input sizes'
    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
    precision = precision_score(y_true, y_pred, average='weighted')
    recall = recall_score(y_true, y_pred, average='weighted')
    f1 = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average='weighted')
    return {'accuracy': accuracy, 'precision': precision, 'recall': recall, 'f1': f1}

def image_processing(image_path):
    if not image_path:
        return 'Invalid image path'
    image = cv2.imread(image_path, cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    if image is None:
        return 'Could not read the image'
    gray_image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    normalized_image = cv2.normalize(gray_image, None, alpha=0, beta=1, norm_type=cv2.NORM_MINMAX, dtype=cv2.CV_32F)
    return normalized_image

def data_storage(data, db_path):
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('BEGIN TRANSACTION')
        cursor.execute('INSERT INTO table_name (column1, column2) VALUES (?, ?)', (data['key1'], data['key2']))
        conn.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback()
        return f'Error: {e}'
    finally:
        conn.close()

    while True:
        paginated_url = f'{api_url}?page={page}'
        try:

            response.raise_for_status()

        data = response.json()
        if not data:

def data_transformation(data):
    if not all(isinstance(item, list) and len(item) == 3 for item in data):
        return 'Invalid data format'
    transformed_data = [{'name': item[0], 'age': item[1], 'country': item[2]} for item in data]
    return transformed_data

def file_read(file_path, encoding='utf-8'):
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding=encoding) as f:
            content = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return 'File not found'
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return 'Encoding error'
    return content

def list_duplicates(seq):
    tally = defaultdict(list)
    for i, item in enumerate(seq):
        tally[item].append(i)
    return [(key, locs) for key, locs in tally.items() if len(locs) > 1]

def web_crawler(start_url, max_depth=3, rate_limit=2):
    def crawl(url, depth):
        if depth > max_depth:
            return
        try:
            time.sleep(rate_limit)
            response = requests.get(url)
            response.raise_for_status()
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            print(f'Failed to fetch {url}: {e}')
            return
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'lxml')
        links = [a['href'] for a in soup.find_all('a', href=True)]
        print(f'Crawled {url} at depth {depth}')
        for link in links:
            crawl(link, depth+1)
    crawl(start_url, 0)

def resize_images(folder_path, output_size=(200, 200)):
    for filename in os.listdir(folder_path):
        if not filename.lower().endswith(('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg')):
            continue
        try:
            img = Image.open(os.path.join(folder_path, filename))
            img = img.resize(output_size, Image.ANTIALIAS)
            img.save(os.path.join(folder_path, f'resized_{filename}'))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Failed to resize {filename}: {e}')

def parse_logs(log_file, level='ERROR'):

        for line in f:

    return error_logs

def machine_learning_model(X, y):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
    model = LogisticRegression()
    params = {'C': [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10], 'penalty': ['l1', 'l2']}
    grid = GridSearchCV(model, params, cv=5)
    grid.fit(X_scaled, y)
    return grid.best_estimator_

def text_analyzer(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
    words = text.split()
    word_count = collections.Counter(words)
    return word_count

def file_encryptor(file_path):
    key = Fernet.generate_key()
    cipher_suite = Fernet(key)
    with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
        content = f.read()
    encrypted_content = cipher_suite.encrypt(content)
    with open(f'{file_path}.enc', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(encrypted_content)
    return key

def web_crawler(start_url):
    visited = set()
    to_visit = deque([start_url])
    while to_visit:
        url = to_visit.popleft()
        if url in visited:
            continue
        try:
            response = requests.get(url)
            response.raise_for_status()
            html_content = response.text
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            print(f'Failed to fetch {url}: {e}')
            continue
        visited.add(url)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'lxml')
        for link in soup.find_all('a'):
            to_visit.append(link.get('href'))

def sentiment_analysis(text):
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]', '', text)
    sentiment_analyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()
    scores = sentiment_analyzer.polarity_scores(text)
    if scores['compound'] > 0.05:
        return 'Positive'
    elif scores['compound'] < -0.05:
        return 'Negative'
    else:
        return 'Neutral'

def text_summary(text, num_sentences=3):
    sentences = sent_tokenize(text)
    return ' '.join(sentences[:num_sentences])

def train_neural_network(X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val):
    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Dense(128, activation='relu'))
    model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='mse', metrics=['mae'])
    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=3)
    log_dir = 'logs/'
    tensorboard_callback = TensorBoard(log_dir=log_dir)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train, epochs=10, validation_data=(X_val, y_val), callbacks=[early_stopping, tensorboard_callback])

def image_classification(img_path, model_path):

        model = load_model(model_path)
        img = cv2.imread(img_path)
        if img is None:

def stock_analysis(stock_data):
    if 'price' not in stock_data or not isinstance(stock_data['price'], list) or not stock_data['price']:
        return 'Invalid data'
    prices = np.array(stock_data['price'])
    average_price = np.mean(prices)
    median_price = np.median(prices)
    std_dev = np.std(prices)
    return {'average': average_price, 'median': median_price, 'std_dev': std_dev}

def time_series_prediction(data):
    if not isinstance(data, pd.Series):
        return 'Invalid data type'
    model = ARIMA(data.dropna(), order=(1,1,1))
    model_fit = model.fit(disp=0)
    residuals = pd.DataFrame(model_fit.resid)
    if residuals.mean()[0] > 0.05:
        return 'Poorly fitted model'
    return model_fit.forecast(steps=5)[0]

def nlp_processing(text):
    try:
        tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(text.lower())
        stemmer = PorterStemmer()
        stemmed_tokens = [stemmer.stem(token) for token in tokens]
        tagged = nltk.pos_tag(stemmed_tokens)
        return nltk.ne_chunk(tagged)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def sentiment_analysis(text):
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]', '', text).lower()
    analyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()
    score = analyzer.polarity_scores(text)['compound']
    if score >= 0.05:
        return 'Positive'
    elif score <= -0.05:
        return 'Negative'
    else:
        return 'Neutral'

def handle_user_input(input_data, actions):
    if not isinstance(input_data, dict) or 'action' not in input_data:
        return 'Invalid input'
    action = input_data.get('action')
    if action not in actions:
        return 'Unknown action'
    try:
        return actions[action]()
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Action failed: {e}'

def calculate_discount(price, discount):
    if not (isinstance(price, (int, float)) and isinstance(discount, (int, float))):
        return 'Invalid input types'
    if price < 0 or discount < 0 or discount > 100:
        return 'Invalid input values'
    return round(price - (price * discount / 100), 2)

def run_ml_pipeline(data, model):
    if 'X' not in data or 'y' not in data:
        return 'Invalid data'
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(data['X'], data['y'], test_size=0.2)
    parameters = {'C': [0.1, 1, 10]}
    grid_search = GridSearchCV(model, parameters)
    grid_search.fit(X_train, y_train)
    best_model = grid_search.best_estimator_
    y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)
    return accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

def process_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return 'Invalid input'
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]\s+', text)
    return [s.strip() for s in sentences if s]

def image_processing(image):
    if not isinstance(image, np.ndarray):
        return 'Invalid image'
    try:
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        blurred = cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (5,5), 0)
        return cv2.Canny(blurred, 50, 150)
    except cv2.error as e:
        return f'OpenCV error: {e}'

def calculate_statistics(data):
    if not isinstance(data, (list, np.ndarray)) or not data:
        return 'Invalid data'
    data = np.array(data)
    mean = np.mean(data)
    variance = np.var(data)

def fetch_currency_exchange_rate(base, target):
    url = f'https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/{base}'
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()
        rate = response.json().get('rates', {}).get(target, None)
        if rate is None:
            return f'{target} rate not found'
        return rate
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def find_anagrams(words):
    anagrams = defaultdict(list)
    for word in words:
        sorted_word = ''.join(sorted(word))
        anagrams[sorted_word].append(word)
    return {k: v for k, v in anagrams.items() if len(v) > 1}

def predict_sales(prices, features, tune=False):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(features, prices, test_size=0.2)
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)
    model = LinearRegression()
    if tune:
        # Add hyperparameter tuning logic here
        pass
    model.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_scaled)
    mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
    return y_pred, mse

def process_image(image_path, resize_dim=(500, 500), color_space='GRAY'):
    if not isinstance(image_path, str) or not image_path:
        return 'Invalid image path'
    image = cv2.imread(image_path)
    if image is None:
        return 'Could not read the image'
    if resize_dim:
        image = cv2.resize(image, resize_dim)
    if color_space == 'GRAY':
        image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    return image

def analyze_sentiment(text, lang='en'):
    if not text.strip():
        return 'Text cannot be empty'
    blob = TextBlob(text)
    if lang != 'en':
        blob = blob.translate(to='en')
    return blob.sentiment.polarity

def get_top_n_words(text, n, case_sensitive=False, remove_punct=True):
    if remove_punct:
        text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
    if not case_sensitive:
        text = text.lower()
    words = text.split()
    word_count = Counter(words)
    return word_count.most_common(n)

def classify_text(text, training_data, training_labels):
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
    X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(training_data)
    clf = MultinomialNB()
    clf.fit(X_train, training_labels)
    X_test = vectorizer.transform([text])
    prediction = clf.predict(X_test)
    return prediction[0]

def scrape_job_listings(url, num_pages=1):

    for page in range(1, num_pages + 1):

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        jobs = soup.find_all('div', {'class': 'job-listing'})
        sanitized_jobs = [job.text.strip().replace('\n', ' ') for job in jobs]

def process_csv(file_path, delimiter=',', skip_header=True):
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        return 'File does not exist'
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
            reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter=delimiter)
            if skip_header:
                next(reader)
            data = [row for row in reader if all(cell.strip() != '' for cell in row)]
        return data
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def generate_histogram(data, xlabel='X-axis', ylabel='Frequency', title='Histogram', normalize=False):
    if normalize:
        weights = [1 / len(data) for _ in data]
        plt.hist(data, weights=weights)
    else:
        plt.hist(data)
    plt.xlabel(xlabel)
    plt.ylabel(ylabel)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.show()

def predict(model, input_data, pre_process_fn, post_process_fn, batch_size=32):
    preprocessed_data = pre_process_fn(input_data)
    predictions = []
    for i in range(0, len(preprocessed_data), batch_size):
        batch = preprocessed_data[i:i+batch_size]
        batch_predictions = model.predict(batch)
        predictions.extend(batch_predictions)
    postprocessed_predictions = post_process_fn(predictions)
    return postprocessed_predictions

def plot_time_series(time_series, time_labels=None, smooth_factor=0, show_grid=False):
    if smooth_factor > 0:
        window = np.ones(smooth_factor)/smooth_factor
        time_series = np.convolve(time_series, window, 'valid')
    plt.plot(time_series)
    if time_labels:
        plt.xticks(ticks=range(len(time_series)), labels=time_labels, rotation=45)
    if show_grid:
        plt.grid(True)
    plt.show()

def tokenize_text(text):
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text).lower()
    tokens = text.split()
    stemmer = PorterStemmer()
    stemmed_tokens = [stemmer.stem(token) for token in tokens]
    return stemmed_tokens

def fetch_weather_data(location, start_date, end_date, fields=['daily_temperatures']):
    base_url = 'https://api.example.com/weather'
    params = {'location': location, 'start': start_date, 'end': end_date, 'page': 1}
    all_data = []
    while True:
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=5)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if not data.get('next_page'): break
            all_data.extend(data.get(fields[0], []))
            params['page'] += 1
        except (requests.RequestException, Exception) as e:
            return f'Error: {e}'
    return all_data

def scrape_website(url):
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
    rate_limit = 1.0
    last_time = 0
    try:
        time_since_last_request = time.time() - last_time
        if time_since_last_request < rate_limit:
            time.sleep(rate_limit - time_since_last_request)
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        titles = soup.find_all('h1')
        for title in titles:
            print(title.text)
        last_time = time.time()
    except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def data_cleanup(df):
    if df.empty:
        return 'DataFrame is empty'
    df.fillna(0, inplace=True)
    if 'price' in df.columns:
        df['price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['price'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    return df

def perform_clustering(data):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    data_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(data)
    optimal_n_clusters = 3
    silhouette_avg = -1
    for n_clusters in range(2, 5):
        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=n_clusters).fit(data_scaled)
        silhouette_avg_n = silhouette_score(data_scaled, kmeans.labels_)
        if silhouette_avg_n > silhouette_avg:
            silhouette_avg = silhouette_avg_n
            optimal_n_clusters = n_clusters
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=optimal_n_clusters).fit(data_scaled)
    return kmeans.labels_

def calculate_statistics(numbers):
    if not numbers:
        return 'List is empty'
    return {'mean': mean(numbers), 'median': median(numbers), 'mode': mode(numbers), 'stdev': stdev(numbers)}

def encrypt_message(message, key=None):
    if not key:
        key = Fernet.generate_key()
    cipher_suite = Fernet(key)
    try:
        encrypted_message = cipher_suite.encrypt(message.encode())
    except InvalidToken as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'
    return encrypted_message, key

def extract_urls(text):
    pattern = r'https?://[\w.-]+(?:\.[\w.-]+)+([\w-./?%&=]*)?'
    return re.findall(pattern, text)

def download_image(url, path):
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()
        if 'image' not in response.headers.get('content-type', ''):
            return 'Not an image URL'
        with open(path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(response.content)
    except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def parse_json_file(file_path, schema):
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        return 'File does not exist'
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        validate(instance=data, schema=schema)
        return data
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, jsonschema.ValidationError) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def fetch_api_data(api_url):
    retries = 3
    delay = 1
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'custom-agent'}
    while retries > 0:
        try:
            response = requests.get(api_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response.json()
        except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:
            retries -= 1
            time.sleep(delay)
            delay *= 2
    return f'Error after {retries} retries'

def filter_dataframe(df, column='age', threshold=18):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        return 'Not a DataFrame'
    if column not in df.columns:
        return 'Invalid column name'
    df = df.dropna(subset=[column])
    return df[df[column] > threshold]

def train_model(X, y):
    try:
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
        selector = SelectKBest(score_func=f_regression, k=5)
        X_selected = selector.fit_transform(X_scaled, y)
        model = LinearRegression()
        model.fit(X_selected, y)
        return model
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def calculate_mean(numbers):
    if not isinstance(numbers, (list, np.ndarray)) or not numbers:
        return 'Invalid input'
    try:
        numbers = np.array(numbers)
        q1 = np.percentile(numbers, 25)
        q3 = np.percentile(numbers, 75)
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lower_bound = q1 - (1.5 * iqr)
        upper_bound = q3 + (1.5 * iqr)
        filtered_numbers = numbers[(numbers >= lower_bound) & (numbers <= upper_bound)]
        return np.mean(filtered_numbers)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def convert_to_json(data):
    try:
        if not isinstance(data, (dict, list, tuple)):
            return 'Invalid data type'
        return json.dumps(data, indent=4, sort_keys=True)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def fetch_tweets(api, username):
    all_tweets = []
    last_tweet_id = None
    while True:
        try:
            if last_tweet_id:
                tweets = api.user_timeline(screen_name=username, count=200, max_id=last_tweet_id - 1)
            else:
                tweets = api.user_timeline(screen_name=username, count=200)
            if not tweets:
                break
            all_tweets.extend(tweets)
            last_tweet_id = tweets[-1].id
        except (RateLimitError, TweepError) as e:
            print(f'Error: {e}')
            break
    return [tweet.text for tweet in all_tweets]

def web_scraper(urls):
    def fetch_url(url):
        try:
            html = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read()
            return html
        except URLError as e:
            return f'Error: {e}'
    with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
        results = executor.map(fetch_url, urls)
    return list(results)

def encrypt_message(message, key):
    if not isinstance(message, bytes) or not isinstance(key, bytes):
        return 'Invalid input types'
    try:
        f = Fernet(key)
        encrypted = f.encrypt(message)
        return encrypted
    except InvalidToken as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def send_email(subject, body, to, attachment_path=None):
    try:
        server = smtplib.SMTP_SSL('smtp.gmail.com', 465)
        server.login('user', 'pass')
        msg = MIMEMultipart()
        msg['From'] = 'user'
        msg['To'] = to
        msg['Subject'] = subject
        msg.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))
        if attachment_path:
            attachment = open(attachment_path, 'rb').read()

        server.sendmail('from', to, msg.as_string())
        server.quit()

        return f'Error: {e}'

def download_pdfs(pdf_links):
    def fetch_pdf(link):
        try:
            filename = link.split('/')[-1]
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(link, filename, reporthook)
        except URLError as e:
            return f'Error: {e}'
    def reporthook(blocknum, blocksize, totalsize):
        readsofar = blocknum * blocksize
        percent = readsofar * 1e2 / totalsize
        print(f'{percent}% downloaded')
    with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
        results = executor.map(fetch_pdf, pdf_links)
    return list(results)

def save_to_csv(data, filename):
    try:
        if not all(isinstance(row, list) for row in data):
            return 'Invalid data format'
        with open(filename, 'w', newline='') as csvfile:
            fcntl.flock(csvfile, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            writer = csv.writer(csvfile)
            writer.writerows(data)
            fcntl.flock(csvfile, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def parse_xml(xml_string, schema_path):
    try:
        schema = XMLSchema(schema_path)
        if not schema.is_valid(xml_string):
            return 'Invalid XML against schema'
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_string)
        ns = {'ns': 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'}
        for child in root.findall('.//ns:element', ns):
            print(child.tag, child.attrib)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

    except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:

def generate_thumbnail(image_path, thumbnail_path):
    try:
        with Image.open(image_path) as image:

            image.thumbnail(new_size)

        return f'Error: {e}'

def read_text_file(file_path, encoding='utf-8'):
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding=encoding) as f:
            for line in f:
                yield line.strip()
    except (FileNotFoundError, UnicodeDecodeError) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def create_zip(files, zip_name, compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED):
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_name, 'w', compression=compression) as zipf:
            for file in files:
                if not os.path.exists(file):
                    return f'{file} does not exist'
                zipf.write(file)
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def calculate_statistics(numbers):
    try:
        mean = sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
        min_val = min(numbers)
        max_val = max(numbers)
        med = median(numbers)
        mod = mode(numbers)
        outliers = [x for x in numbers if x < mean - 2 * mod or x > mean + 2 * mod]
        return {'mean': mean, 'min': min_val, 'max': max_val, 'median': med, 'mode': mod, 'outliers': outliers}
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def sort_list(lst, key_func=None):
    try:
        filtered_lst = [x for x in lst if x is not None]
        sorted_lst = sorted(filtered_lst, key=key_func) if key_func else sorted(filtered_lst)
        return sorted_lst
    except TypeError as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def search_text(pattern, text):
    try:
        optimized_pattern = r'\b' + re.escape(pattern) + r'\b'
        return re.findall(optimized_pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)
    except re.error as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def read_csv(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            result = chardet.detect(f.read())
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding=result['encoding']) as f:
            reader = csv.Sniffer().sniff(f.read(1024))
            f.seek(0)
            reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter=reader.delimiter)
            next(reader, None)
            for row in reader:
                print(row)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def fibonacci(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    else:
        return fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2)

def deep_merge(dict1, dict2):
    for k, v in dict2.items():
        if k in dict1 and isinstance(dict1[k], dict) and isinstance(v, dict):
            deep_merge(dict1[k], v)
        else:
            dict1[k] = v

def merge_dictionaries(dict1, dict2):
    merged_dict = defaultdict(dict)
    deep_merge(merged_dict, dict1)
    deep_merge(merged_dict, dict2)
    return dict(merged_dict)

def api_data_extraction(api_url, per_page=50):
    all_data = []
    page = 1
    rate_limit = 1.0
    last_time = 0
    try:
        while True:
            time_since_last_request = time.time() - last_time
            if time_since_last_request < rate_limit:
                time.sleep(rate_limit - time_since_last_request)
            response = requests.get(f'{api_url}?page={page}&per_page={per_page}', timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            if not data:
                break
            all_data.extend(data)
            page += 1
            last_time = time.time()
        return all_data
    except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def data_preprocessing(df):
    try:
        df.dropna(inplace=True)
        df = df.apply(lambda x: x.str.lower() if x.dtype == 'object' else x)
        num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['float64', 'int64']).columns
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        df[num_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(df[num_cols])
        df = df.convert_dtypes()
        return df
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def user_authentication(username, password):
    hashed_password = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    if username in failed_attempts and time.time() - failed_attempts[username]['timestamp'] < 60:
        return 'Account locked'
    if username in user_db:
        if hashed_password == user_db[username]:
            return 'Authenticated'
        else:
            failed_attempts[username] = {'count': failed_attempts.get(username, {'count': 0})['count'] + 1, 'timestamp': time.time()}
            if failed_attempts[username]['count'] >= 3:
                return 'Account locked'
            return 'Authentication failed'
    else:
        return 'User not found'

def twitter_bot(api_key, api_secret, tweet):
    rate_limit = 1.0
    last_time = 0
    try:
        auth = tweepy.OAuthHandler(api_key, api_secret)
        api = tweepy.API(auth)
        if len(tweet) > 280:
            return 'Tweet exceeds character limit'
        time_since_last_request = time.time() - last_time
        if time_since_last_request < rate_limit:
            time.sleep(rate_limit - time_since_last_request)
        api.update_status(status=tweet)
        last_time = time.time()
    except (TweepError, RateLimitError) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def video_processing(video_path, output_format='avi'):
    try:
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)
        fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'XVID')
        out = cv2.VideoWriter(f'output.{output_format}', fourcc, 20.0, (640,480))
        while cap.isOpened():
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            out.write(frame)
            cv2.imshow('Video', frame)
            if cv2.waitKey(1) & 0xFF == ord('q'):
                break
        cap.release()
        out.release()
        cv2.destroyAllWindows()
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def pdf_parser(file_path, search_term=None):
    try:
        pdf = PdfFileReader(file_path)
        if pdf.isEncrypted:
            return 'Encrypted PDF, unable to parse'
        text = ''
        metadata = pdf.getDocumentInfo()
        for i in range(pdf.getNumPages()):
            text += pdf.getPage(i).extractText()
        if search_term:
            return {'text': text, 'metadata': metadata, 'search_term_occurrences': text.count(search_term)}
        return {'text': text, 'metadata': metadata}
    except PdfReadError as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def image_classification(image_path, model_type='VGG16', confidence_threshold=0.5):
    try:
        img = image.load_img(image_path, target_size=(224, 224))
        x = image.img_to_array(img)
        x = preprocess_input(x)
        if model_type == 'VGG16':
            model = VGG16(weights='imagenet')
        elif model_type == 'ResNet50':
            model = ResNet50(weights='imagenet')
        preds = model.predict(x)
        decoded_preds = decode_predictions(preds, top=3)[0]
        return [pred for pred in decoded_preds if pred[2] >= confidence_threshold]
    except UnidentifiedImageError as e:
        return f'Error: Unsupported image type {e}'

def data_encryption(text, key_path='key.key'):
    try:
        key = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(Fernet.generate_key())
        with open(key_path, 'wb') as key_file:
            key_file.write(key)
        cipher_suite = Fernet(key)
        encrypted_text = cipher_suite.encrypt(text.encode())
        return encrypted_text
    except InvalidToken as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def download_audio_from_youtube(url, bitrate='128kbps', output_name='audio'):
    try:
        yt = YouTube(url)
        stream = yt.streams.filter(only_audio=True, file_extension='mp4').order_by('abr').first()
        if stream.abr != bitrate:
            stream = yt.streams.filter(only_audio=True, abr=bitrate).first()
        if not stream:
            return 'No matching audio stream found'
        stream.download(filename=output_name)
    except exceptions.PytubeError as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def audio_transcription(audio_path, language='en-US'):
    recognizer = sr.Recognizer()
    try:
        with sr.AudioFile(audio_path) as source:
            recognizer.adjust_for_ambient_noise(source)
            audio_data = recognizer.record(source)
        text = recognizer.recognize_google(audio_data, language=language)
        return text
    except sr.UnknownValueError:
        return 'Could not understand audio'
    except sr.RequestError as e:
        return f'Could not request results; {e}'

def download_file(url, filename):
    try:
        with requests.get(url, stream=True) as r:
            r.raise_for_status()
            total_size = int(r.headers.get('content-length', 0))
            with open(filename, 'wb') as f:
                for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):
                    f.write(chunk)
        return 'Download successful'
    except (HTTPError, Timeout) as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def extract_zip(zip_path, output_path, password=None, specific_files=None):
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            if password:
                zip_ref.setpassword(password.encode())
            if specific_files:
                for file in specific_files:
                    zip_ref.extract(file, output_path)
            else:
                zip_ref.extractall(output_path)
        return 'Extraction successful'
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def nlp_pipeline(text):
    try:
        nlp = spacy.load('en_core_web_sm')
        doc = nlp(text)
        tokens = [token.text for token in doc]
        pos_tags = [token.pos_ for token in doc]
        ner_tags = [(ent.text, ent.label_) for ent in doc.ents]
        dependencies = [(token.text, token.dep_) for token in doc]
        return {'tokens': tokens, 'pos_tags': pos_tags, 'ner_tags': ner_tags, 'dependencies': dependencies}
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def get_top_n_words(text, n):
    try:
        text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text).lower()
        words = text.split()
        counter = Counter(words)
        return counter.most_common(n)
    except Exception as e:
        return f'Error: {e}'

def quick_sort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
    left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
    middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
    return quick_sort(left) + middle + quick_sort(right)

def median(arr):
    if len(arr) == 0:
        return None
    sortedArr = sorted(arr)
    length = len(arr)
    if length % 2 == 0:
        return ((sortedArr[length//2-1] + sortedArr[length//2])/2)
    else:
        return sortedArr[length//2]

def sum_of_list(my_list):
    if not all(isinstance(i, (int, float)) for i in my_list):
        return 'Error: All elements in the list must be numbers'
    sum = 0
    for number in my_list:
        sum = sum + number
    return sum

def first_non_repeating_char(input_str):
    if not isinstance(input_str, str):
        return 'Error: Input must be a string'
    char_count = {}
    for ch in input_str:
        if ch in char_count:
            char_count[ch] += 1
        else:
            char_count[ch] = 1
    for ch in input_str:
        if char_count[ch] == 1:
            return ch
    return None

def count_chars(string):
    if not isinstance(string, str):
        return 'Error: Input must be a string'
    char_occurrences = {}
    for char in string:
        if char not in char_occurrences:
            char_occurrences[char] = 1
        else:
            char_occurrences[char] += 1
    return char_occurrences

def generate_primes(n):
    primes = []
    i = 2
    while len(primes) < n:
        for p in primes:
            if i % p == 0:
                break
        else:
            primes.append(i)
        i += 1
    return primes

def common_elements(list1, list2):

def longest_palindrome(string):
    if not isinstance(string, str):
        return 'Error: Input must be a string'
    palindrome = ''
    for i in range(len(string)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(string)+1):
            substring = string[i:j]
            if substring == substring[::-1] and len(substring) > len(palindrome):
                palindrome = substring
    return palindrome

def intersection(list1, list2):
    return list(set(list1) & set(list2))

def isArmstrongNumber(num):
    if not isinstance(num, int):
        return 'Error: Input must be an integer'
    sum = 0
    temp = num
    while temp > 0:
        digit = temp % 10
        sum += digit ** 3
        temp //= 10
    if num == sum:
        return True
    else:
        return False

 if num <= 1: 
 return False
 if num == 2:
 return True
 if num % 2 == 0:
 return False
 for i in range(3, int(num**0.5) + 1, 2):

 return True

def longest_common_prefix(arr_of_dictionaries):
 if len(arr_of_dictionaries) == 0:
 return ''
 keys = [set(d.keys()) for d in arr_of_dictionaries]
 common_keys = set.intersection(*keys)
 prefix = ''
 for key in common_keys:
 if key.startswith(prefix):
 prefix = key
 return prefix

class Stack: 
    def __init__(self): 
        self.stack = []

    def push(self,element): 
        self.stack.append(element)  

    def pop(self): 
        if not self.stack:
            return 'Error: Stack is empty'
        return self.stack.pop()

    def peek(self):
        if not self.stack:
            return 'Error: Stack is empty'
        return self.stack[-1]

def build_model(X, y):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=0)
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    print('Mean squared error: %.2f' % mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred))
    print('Coefficient of determination: %.2f' % r2_score(y_test, y_pred))

    for item in data:
        item['age'] = int(item['age']) if item['age'] else None
        item['income'] = int(item['income'].replace('$', '').replace(',', '')) if item['income'] else None

def SortArray(array):
    if not isinstance(array, list):
        return 'Error: Input is not a list'
    for i in range(len(array)):
        for j in range(len(array) - i - 1):
            if array[j] > array[j + 1]:
                array[j], array[j + 1] = array[j + 1], array[j]
    return array

def multiply_matrices(matrixA, matrixB): 
 if not all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrixA) or not all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrixB):
 return 'Error: Input is not a 2D array'
 result_matrix = [[0 for _ in range(len(matrixB[0]))] for _ in range(len(matrixA))]

 for i in range(len(matrixA)): 
 for j in range(len(matrixB[0])): 
 for k in range(len(matrixB)): 
 result_matrix[i][j] += matrixA[i][k] * matrixB[k][j] 
 
 return result_matrix

def find_dates(text):
    pattern = '\b(19[0-9]{2}|20[0-1][0-9]|202[0-3])\b'
    years = re.findall(pattern, text)
    pattern = '\b(0[1-9]|1[0-2])\b'
    months = re.findall(pattern, text)
    return {'years': years, 'months': months}

def find_urls(text):
    pattern = 'https?://(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\\(\\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+'
    return re.findall(pattern, text)

def find_prices(text):
    pattern = r'\\\$([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)'
    return re.findall(pattern, text)

class Customer:
    def __init__(self, name, address, email):
        if not all(isinstance(i, str) for i in [name, address, email]):
            raise ValueError('All inputs must be strings')
        self.name = name
        self.address = address
        self.email = email

    def get_name(self):
        return self.name

    def set_name(self, name):
        self.name = name

    def get_address(self):
        return self.address

    def set_address(self, address):
        self.address = address

    def get_email(self):
        return self.email

    def set_email(self, email):
        self.email = email

def shuffleArray(arr):
    if not isinstance(arr, list):
        return 'Error: Input is not a list'
    temp_arr = arr.copy()
    for i in range(len(temp_arr)):
        j = random.randint(0, len(temp_arr)-1)
        temp_arr[i], temp_arr[j] = temp_arr[j], temp_arr[i]
    return temp_arr

def open_notepad():
    if platform.system() == 'Windows':
        try:
            shell32 = ctypes.windll.shell32
            if hasattr(shell32, 'ShellExecuteW'):
                shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, 'open', 'notepad.exe', None, None, 1)
            else:
                return 'ShellExecuteW not found'
        except AttributeError:
            return 'Method not found'
    else:
        return 'Unsupported platform'
